name: social-connect
description: Lets your AI assistant read your own Telegram and personal WhatsApp (beta) chats through the hosted Social Connect MCP server: sign in with an email code, connect by scanning a QR code, list recent chats across both, read recent messages, and propose a reply that is never sent unless you approve it in the web app. Includes headless agent sign-up for autonomous agents with their own mailbox, and reading etiquette (ask first, summarize, bounded reads).
